summary: One blocking finding should be applied: schema-default alignment must cover every built-in default provider entry reachable by docs.text, not only Codex.

items.title: Default docs.text path is not covered by schema-default alignment
items.rationale: The finding is grounded in verified source context and can be fixed by broadening the spec requirement, acceptance criterion, and task text. Leaving R2 Codex-only would allow the default docs.text profile path to miss schema flags.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R2 and task T-4 currently name Codex provider defaults. spec-review.json notes docs.text routes to claude/sonnet in built-in profiles and src/lib/agent-defaults.js provider pool entries override schema-capable provider.js profiles.
